description: Send a message to a channel or thread: text, embeds, files/images (local paths or URLs; show one inside an embed with image "attachment://name.png"), link buttons, a poll, a reply, and pings. Nobody is pinged unless listed in ping_roles/ping_users/ping_everyone. To correct a post without the "(edited)" mark, use replace: the new message is sent and the old ones are deleted, and its mentions show without notifying anyone again.

bot.description: Use this bot (name or id) instead of choosing automatically

channel.description: Channel or thread name, id, or message link

confirm.description: With replace, when permanent actions need confirming: true to really send and delete; without it you get a preview

dry_run.description: Show the requests that would be made without changing anything

color.description: Hex like "#57F287", a name like "green", or a number

image.description: Big image: a URL, or "attachment://file.png" for a file sent with the message

thumbnail.description: Small image on the right: URL or "attachment://file.png"

timestamp.description: true for now, or an ISO date

name.description: File name in Discord (use it in attachment://name)

source.description: Local file path or http(s) URL

notify_again.description: With replace: notify the pinged roles and members again (default: no, the mentions only show)

publish.description: Announcement channels: send to following servers

replace.description: Ids or links of earlier messages in this channel that this message replaces: they are deleted once it is sent (a clean repost, with no "(edited)" mark)

server.description: Server name or id. Optional when the bot is in one server or DISCORD_GUILD_ID is set.

name: send_message
